awin-beyond-memories-3d-memory-crystaltm: 3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Rectangle - For Mom-4K HD / Small

The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle for Mom is a Mother's Day, birthday, or just-because keepsake that turns your favorite photo of Mom into a piece of K9 optical crystal she can keep on her nightstand, mantel, or desk for life. The rectangle is the classic Beyond Memories® portrait shape - your photo sculpted in three dimensions and laser-engraved inside a block of crystal so it can be seen from every angle. Pair it with a Memory Light Base™ for soft illumination from below and the engraving glows even in dim evening light. Every Rectangle for Mom starts with the photo you upload at checkout. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the image for laser clarity, our artists set up the 3D engraving model, and a 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal - building Mom's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. Hand-polished, inspected, packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms. 100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant, never fades Rectangle portrait orientation - the natural format for vertical family photos 4K laser engraving - millions of refractive points etched inside the crystal volume Expert photo enhancement included - we touch up exposure, color, and background before engraving Available in five sizes from Small to Max - pick the size that suits her display surface Standard or 4K HD engraving - HD gives the finest gradient, most noticeable up close Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Perfect for Mom's milestones The Rectangle for Mom is the Beyond Memories crystal most-ordered for Mother's Day, but it works for every milestone in Mom's calendar. Engrave a photo from her wedding day for a 25th, 40th, or 50th anniversary. Use a Grandma-and-grandkids photo for her 70th or 80th birthday. Pull a candid from a recent family vacation for a just-because gift she'll display year-round. The rectangle's vertical format suits portraits of one to four people; for larger family groups, the classic Rectangle portrait in a larger size has more room. How the personalization works The engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload Mom's photo at checkout, our design team reviews it and enhances it for engraving clarity - sharpening detail, balancing exposure, simplifying busy backgrounds where helpful. We then convert the photo into a 3D model that maps to the rectangle's dimensions. The 4K laser leaves microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming Mom's image with lifelike volume. The engraving sits suspended in the glass - visible from the front, faintly visible from the sides, glowing softly from below when paired with a Memory Light Base. What photo works best A clear, well-lit photo in JPG or PNG format - ideally 2,000 px on the long edge or larger - gives the sharpest engraving. The rectangle favors vertical portraits: solo Mom, Mom with one or two grandkids, Mom and Dad together. Avoid heavy filters, low resolution, or shots where Mom's face is small in the frame. Plain or softly-blurred backgrounds engrave with more depth than busy ones. Our design team reviews every upload and will reach out if a photo needs to be re-cropped or replaced before production starts. What's in the box Your crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. A folded handwritten card slot lets you add a personal note inside the box. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable. Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe - the engraving is locked inside the glass, not on its surface. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth to remove fingerprints from the edges. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight, which is the only environment that can dim a 3D photo crystal over a span of decades. A drop of dish soap in warm water is safe for occasional deeper cleaning. The crystal pairs naturally with any indoor surface - mantel, nightstand, bookshelf, console table, or display cabinet. Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination with rates calculated at checkout. Add a cutoff date in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production starts. Frequently asked questions Which size should I pick for Mom? Small is best for a desk or nightstand; Medium and Large suit a mantel or bookshelf; XL and Max are showpieces for a console table or display cabinet. If she'll display it close to where she sits, Small is plenty. Does the crystal need a light base? No - the engraving is visible in normal indoor light. A Memory Light Base adds gentle illumination from below and makes the engraving glow in dim rooms (evenings, dimmer-lit corners). Worth it if Mom will display it somewhere without strong daylight. Can I add a name, date, or message? Yes - add your text in Special Instructions at checkout (no extra charge). Names work well below the portrait; dates engrave cleanly in the corners. Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD packs about 50% more dots - finer gradient, smoother skin tones, sharpest at close viewing. Standard is still excellent and most customers can't tell the difference at arm's length. How long does it last? Indefinitely. The engraving is permanent inside the K9 crystal - it does not fade, peel, or scratch off. See our guide on how long 3D crystals last.
